definition: used before saying what you really think
description: A mirror view in a clothes shop with red velvet changing room curtains and hanging rails. A smiling young woman with long braids twirls in a bright lime green tiered tulle dress and chunky white trainers, the skirt swinging out around her. Next to her a young blonde woman in a camel coat, black top and leather skirt stands with her arms folded and watches with a doubtful, frank expression. Other shoppers look through the rails behind them, and autumn trees show through the window.
